entries.name: imToken token-ui
entries.notes: SELECTED Web foundation (Phase 5, inspected 2026-11-10: commit 6380d5d4 exists, dated 2026-05-14; MIT licence confirmed; 107 files; React + Vite + pnpm 10.33.0, Node >=22.12.0. No mnemonic, private-key, seed, keystore, fetch, axios, RPC or WalletConnect code; localStorage only for the theme preference. Provides no engine, derivation, vault, custody, signing, RPC or indexing. Mock data must be replaced by the Bawa engine boundary in Phase 6. See templates/web/UPSTREAM.md.

entries.name: Tether WDK Starter Kotlin
entries.notes: SELECTED Android foundation, UI LAYER ONLY (Phase 5, inspected 2026-11-10: commit a4fa2172 exists, dated 2026-09-30; Apache-2.0 confirmed; 20 files; Gradle 8.7, AGP 8.2.2, Kotlin 1.9.22, Compose BOM 2024.02.00, JVM 17 — JDK 17 CONFIRMED by the starter. Its wdk-core-kotlin engine module is OUTSIDE this repo (settings.gradle includes it from ../wdk-core-kotlin), so the starter does NOT build standalone; UI-only adoption must remove that dependency and all WdkCore imports and rebuild the protected 24-word ceremony. 7 screens present (Welcome/Create/Import/Home/Send/Receive/Sign); 7 of the 14-screen contract still missing. See templates/android/UPSTREAM.md.

entries.name: XChain Platform Wallet
entries.notes: Pin 3e550d05e913e29e5c3cf24527bf504f1a4fe942 verified as master HEAD, commit 2026-11-01, release v0.342.1. AGPL-3.0-or-later confirmed in package.json, README SPDX line and LICENSE.md (full AGPL v3 text). Self-custodial multi-chain React wallet: web, Chrome extension, desktop, Android. BTC/LTC/DOGE at launch; no ETH at this pin. LTC/DOGE are outside the registry chain enum. The old UNVERIFIED finding tested the wrong repo: xchainjs/xchainjs-lib, a separate MIT-licensed THORChain client library; this pin returns 'not our ref' there. Research-only; no copying without a licensing decision.
